messages:
Priya (AM): @Ethan quick sync — need to lock POC success criteria and compute runway so we can send a quote + security answers.
Ethan (Customer): High level: support-assistant for agents. Target 15k MAU, ~3 sessions/user/day, ~1.2k tokens/session avg. Peak expected during morning shift ~60 concurrent sessions. Latency target: p95 <= 350ms. Timeline: 6 week POC.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Got it. Two quick q's: 1) Are sessions mostly generate-only or streaming? 2) Any hard requirement on model family (Llama/Redwood/open)?
Ethan (Customer): Mostly generate-only (short streams fine), model preference is an open LLaMA-v2 variant. Quality > cost is leaning quality but want to see cost options.
Sam (Solutions Eng): OK. Quick rough throughput calc and costs — assuming SDK batching and 512k seq perf baseline.
Sam (Solutions Eng): ```
# rough token and QPS calc
MAU = 15000
sessions_per_day = 3
avg_tokens = 1200
monthly_tokens = MAU * sessions_per_day * 30 * avg_tokens  # ~1.62B tokens
peak_concurrency = 60  # sessions concurrently during peak
avg_tokens_per_sec_per_session = 1200 / 30  # assume 30s session => 40 tps
peak_token_rate = peak_concurrency * 40  # ~2400 tokens/sec
```
Sam (Solutions Eng): With a LLaMA-v2-13b quantized perf, empirically we see ~2k-3k tokens/s per A100-80GB depending on batch/seq. So one A100 could likely handle peak with modest headroom if we tune batching and caching. But latency SLO p95 350ms means we probably want 2x for safe run — recommend 2x A100 in Dedicated pool for POC.
Jon (Infra): Cost math: A100-80GB hourly price (internal) ~ $2.6/hr. For 2 GPUs 24/7 for 6 weeks: 2 * 2.6 * 24 * 7 * 6 = ~$5222. Add infra overhead (load balancer + fallback model + storage) ~ +15% => ~$6000.
Jon (Infra): If customer prefers lower-cost, we can offer a q4_8 quantized 13b on T4-like instance: ~0.6k tokens/s per GPU — would need ~4 GPUs; cheaper per-hour but more instances to manage. Tradeoff: latency higher and less headroom.
Lena (Security): SSQ/infosec items flagged: data residency (need EU region option), encryption at rest, KMS integration, and SOC2 + pen test reports. Also customer wants assurance on isolated tenancy for POC data.
Priya (AM): Ethan — can you confirm whether EU region is required for POC or just for production? That changes our approach.
Ethan (Customer): EU region required for POC (data must stay in EU). Also we need KMS and audit logs for any PII handling.
Lena (Security): For POC we can offer Dedicated in eu-west-1 with customer-managed KMS and audit logs enabled. I will attach our SOC2 summary and pen-test stub. Need to collect the specific SSQ items — send me their questionnaire.
Ethan (Customer): Sending questionnaire now (via email). Will also share a small redacted dataset for evals.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Next: I'll assemble a short perf runbook with recommended instance types, batching config, and expected p95 numbers. Will include fallback model mapping (13b quantized -> 7b cheap) for graceful degradation.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Example runtime config snippet for POC:
Sam (Solutions Eng): ```yaml
deployment:
  type: dedicated
  region: eu-west-1
  gpus:
    - type: a100-80gb
      count: 2
runtime:
  batch_max_tokens: 4096
  latency_slo_p95_ms: 350
  kv_cache: enabled
  quantization_profile: q4_0
``` 
Priya (AM): Nice. For pricing doc I need a 1-page quote with: compute cost, estimated token cost (hosted API if used), security add-ons, and a 6-week timeline with milestones (kickoff, ingest & evals, perf tuning, final review). Can we have that by EOD Fri?
Jon (Infra): I'll run a quick cost table and include the alternative T4 path. ETA Thu EOD.
Lena (Security): I'll draft the SSQ answers and KMS onboarding steps. ETA Thu midday.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll drop perf artifacts and a short eval harness (prompt sets + pass/fail criteria) into the POC template: <https://redwood.internal/poc-templates|poc-templates>. ETA Thu EOD.
Priya (AM): Great — I'll stitch into a single email to the customer with ask for dataset + questionnaire. 
Ethan (Customer): Thanks all. If we can get the EU Dedicated quote + SSQ answers by Friday that'll be ideal. One more ask: can we get a short demo of failover to smaller model in case of load? :pray:
Sam (Solutions Eng): Yep — I'll include a short demo script and a toggled canary policy (A/B fallback) in the runbook.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: reserve-dedicated-pool eu-west-1 (2x a100) requested by Priya — ETA provisioning 2h after approval.
Priya (AM): Action items summary: Sam -> perf runbook + demo script; Jon -> cost tables + alt config; Lena -> SSQ answers + docs; Priya -> customer email and quote. Target deliverable: unified POC packet by Fri EOD. :thumbsup:
